resources.name: Boltztrap
resources.notes: Semiclassical Boltzmann transport code used to compute Seebeck coefficient and ZT from DFT band structure.

resources.name: Crystal structure of CeRu4Sb12

access.notes: Space group Im-3 (No. 204), Ce at (0,0,0), Ru at (0.25,0.25,0.25), Sb at (0,0.35,0.16). The lattice constant is to be optimized; an initial guess can be taken from experiment (~9.266 Å) or from the paper's PBE-GGA value.

resources.notes: Public crystallographic data; the atomic positions are stated in the paper and can be used directly.
